anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Buffer differential pressure was 2.0 mbar, consistent with the preceding 1.7–2.3 mbar baseline.
Buffer differential pressure abruptly increased to 5.7 mbar.
Buffer differential pressure remains elevated at 5.0 mbar.
System pressure fell to 293.9 mbar from 298.5 mbar at 1080 s.
System pressure partially recovered to 296.6 mbar.
Column differential pressure is 0.0 mbar; the buffer pressure increase is not accompanied by a comparable column differential-pressure increase.

args.missing_evidence: Check whether a commanded pressure or valve transition explains the buffer-pressure step; verify PDI702 independently and inspect buffer/vacuum-path status to distinguish a process restriction from a measurement fault. Temperature sensors are not installed, and no composition measurement is available to assess separation.
